verdict.rationale: Shortwave does ship automations (AI filters written in plain English, and triggers that draft replies or organize threads), so this axis applies. However, no evidence shows version history, review, or rollback for those automations. 'Undo send' reverts a sent email to a draft, which is an adjacent feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
